queries: TheAgentCompany benchmark leaderboard best agent task completion 2026
Remote Labor Index AI agents automation rate arXiv Scale AI Center for AI Safety

sources_considered.why: TheAgentCompany paper, revised May 2025. It reports the best agent completing 30% of realistic workplace tasks.
Remote Labor Index, October 2025. The best agent automated 2.5% of real freelance projects.
Third-party aggregator claiming 52.4% in August 2026. I could not verify it against the official leaderboard, and it would still not show reliability.
Secondary roundup. I did not read it and could not verify it.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv (Xu et al., Carnegie Mellon University)

receipt.public_excerpt: the most competitive agent can complete 30% of tasks autonomously.

evidence_items.explanation: On a realistic simulated workplace benchmark, the best agent completed only 30% of tasks. Agents were not yet reliable in real-world-like work, so the antecedent had not happened.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv (Mazeika et al., Center for AI Safety and Scale AI)

receipt.public_excerpt: AI agents perform near the floor on RLI, with the highest-performing agent achieving an automation rate of 2.5%.

evidence_items.explanation: On real freelance projects, the best agent automated 2.5%. As of late 2025, the condition of agents working reliably in the real world had not been met.

unresolved_gaps: I found no verified official evaluation from 2026 showing whether agent reliability rose sharply before the evaluation date.
Even if agents became reliable, no agreed test exists for whether they 'have common sense'.
